evidence.title: Apple announces the HomePod Mini 2, but it isn’t ready for Siri AI at launch

units.text: Apple is announcing the long-awaited HomePod Mini 2 with a new chip that can power Siri AI — but support for those new AI features won’t be available at launch. The speaker is also getting a new sound glow feature that syncs its LED lights with a song’s album art, and it can now be your Mac’s default speaker. Up to four can also pair with the new Apple TV 4K for surround sound. And like everything this year, it’s more expensive, too.

The HomePod Mini 2 comes in pink, green, and a new shade of blue, along with white and black. It costs $149, $20 more than its predecessor, which is being discontinued. Preorders open today, October 13th, and it will ship on October 30th. Apple announced the smart speaker alongside a suite of new products for the home, including the new HomeView smart display ($299), the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K ($299), and a new collection of smart home devices developed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric starting at $199.
[Image: The HomePod Mini 2 in pink. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-HomePod-mini-2-connected-home.png?quality=90&strip=all]

The biggest upgrade inside the HomePod Mini 2 is the S10 chip, which debuted in the Apple Watch Series 10 in 2024. Here, it will enable Siri AI and bring smarter, more conversational responses to the speaker. However, the Mini 2 won’t ship with Siri AI at launch; instead, Apple says it will arrive in a later software update. It will be available in English in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and India. You’ll need an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone — an iPhone 15 Pro or newer — to enable the upgrade.

Once upgraded, you’ll get the same Siri AI as on compatible iPhones, capable of understanding natural language commands and accessing what Apple calls “broader world knowledge,” as well as your personal context, such as your calendar and text messages. Apple’s examples include: if you ask Siri to set a reminder to buy flowers for mom’s birthday, it can check your calendar, identify when mom’s birthday is, and set the reminder. It can also scan your text messages for music recommendations so you can ask it to play that song your friend sent.
[Video: Apple HomePod Mini 2 Sound Glow]

Personal context will be available only on the Mini if you have an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, and will rely on voice recognition to keep your personal information private, but anyone in the home can talk to the HomePod to ask questions, play music, and control most smart home devices. Apple confirmed that Siri AI will not be coming to existing HomePod Minis.

The speakers don’t appear to have been upgraded from the original Mini, with Apple saying they offer the same great sound, but they do get three new audio features: sound glow, audio companion capability for your Mac, and surround sound support on the new Apple TV 4K.
[Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xLL4UnrLNWs]

Sound glow matches the colors of a song’s album art with the LEDs on top of the speaker. I saw a demo in a brightly lit room, and it was subtle, but the colors clearly changed in sync with the music. It also works with Apple’s ambient soundscapes, such as rain, forest, and ocean sounds.

The Mini 2 can now serve as your Mac’s default speaker and work as a surround-sound pair with the new Apple TV 4K, also announced today for $299. The new colors match a few of the current iMacs; I saw the pink pairing, and it was very pretty. Apple says the Mini uses a new audio companion feature that enables a persistent AirPlay setup and optimizes the streaming architecture for low-latency, responsive sound. It works on any model that supports Wi-Fi 6E or higher. I saw a demo of Angry Birds and the fruit-flinging on screen synced seamlessly with the splat sounds emanating from two Minis.

[Image: Some of the HomePod Mini 2 colors match the current iMac line. You can pair two as the default speakers for your Mac. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Apple-HomePod-mini-2-with-Mac.png?quality=90&strip=all]

You’ll be able to pair up to four of the Mini 2 speakers with the new Apple TV 4K for a surround sound home theatre setup. Two Minis can also work with a pair of the second-gen full-sized HomePods for fuller sound. Apple says the speakers automatically calibrate with the Apple TV 4K to understand where they are in the room and relative to each other, then tune the audio levels to fit the space.

The first-generation HomePod Mini launched six years ago today, so a full upgrade was long overdue. The jump from the S5 chip the OG Mini ran on to the S10, and the bump up to Wi-Fi 6E and BLE 6.0, should also improve speed and responsiveness.

It’s disappointing that the Mini hasn’t gotten a significant audio upgrade, but the addition of a smarter Siri, when it arrives, should make the speaker more useful at home. However, it’s surprising that Apple launched this without Siri AI, meaning even if you spend $149 on a new Mini, you’ll still have a disconnect between Siri on your phone and Siri in your home. Combined with the fact that Siri AI is in beta on the new Apple TV 4K, it sounds like Apple’s smart voice assistant isn’t quite ready for primetime after all.
The HomePod Mini 2 in pink.
Some of the HomePod Mini 2 colors match the current iMac line. You can pair two as the default speakers for your Mac.

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple has tried talking around the issue and even shown Apple TV screenshots, but now it's clear the new HomeView cannot play Apple TV or other video apps unless there's a CarPlay app for it. You'd be forgiven for assuming this means you can watch Apple TV on HomeView, but Apple sidesteps telling you how - image credit: Apple. HomeView looked at first to be great if you only wanted Apple's own apps, but now it seems you aren't even getting all of those. There are four Apple apps that have to be run on an iPhone instead: Apple TV Apple Books audiobooks Apple Music Classical Apple News+ Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月14日消息，日前， 苹果发布首款智能家庭中枢设备——HomeView，售价299美元（约合人民币2001元）。 据介绍，苹果HomeView定位家庭智能控制中心，配备7英寸显示屏，搭载A18芯片，支持家庭设备控制、Siri交互以及多用户识别等功能。 苹果HomeView 苹果HomeView发布后，小米中国区智能硬件市场负责人“Selen7”分享了一段关于智能硬件命名的经历。 他表示， 当年为智能硬件产品做命名时，曾规划过一套Home系列名称，最终路由器产品采用了HomeWiFi这一命名。 而在智能音箱产品方面，HomeView这个名字也曾进入小米内部方案。 据其透露， 智能音箱的HomeView只躺在了2021年的历史文档里，最终上市时采用了“智能家庭屏”这一名称。 据了解，小米智能家庭屏定位家庭智能中控入口，可连接米家生态设备，实现灯光、家电、安防等智能设备的统一管理。 近年来，随着智能家居生态持续发展，带屏智能中控设备逐渐成为各大厂商布局家庭场景的重要入口，苹果、谷歌、亚马逊以及国内厂商均推出了相关产品。

evidence.title: Meet Apple HomeView, a new way to enjoy entertainment and manage the home

units.text: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple HomeView, designed to be central to the home and personal to everyone in it. With a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display, HomeView brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all designed with privacy and security at the core.1 HomeView recognizes users by their faces, adapting so they can access their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that’s profoundly more capable and conversational, with broad world knowledge that powers richer music discovery and onscreen awareness. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device, it can also draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more helpful, personalized responses.2 Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Pre-orders start today, with availability beginning November 13. “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user,” said Greg Joswiak, Apple’s senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing. “It recognizes your face to shift from a household screen to your own experience, fills the room with incredible sound, keeps you connected to the people who matter most with FaceTime, and makes it easy to control your smart home. And it’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure.”
HomeView brings people together around one shared experience, while recognizing each user and adapting to them privately.
HomeView brings people together around one shared experience, while recognizing each user and adapting to them privately.
HomeView brings people together around one shared experience, while recognizing each user and adapting to them privately.

HomeView features a beautiful aluminum design with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display connected to a domed speaker base by a stainless steel hinge that provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height. The perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table, HomeView comes in four beautiful colors — silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray — each finished with a matching cable.
HomeView is available in four beautiful colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray.
A Liquid Retina display connected to a domed base by a stainless steel hinge provides a smooth tilt for comfortable viewing on tabletops of any height.
HomeView comes with a color-matched USB-C cable.

The elegant design and Liquid Retina display seamlessly blend into any space while remaining clearly visible from across the room. It features adaptive display technologies, including True Tone, that react to changing light throughout the day. Automatic brightness adjusts from 500 nits — bright enough to stay vivid and easy to see even in a sunlit room — down to just 0.3 nits, making it ideal for the nightstand. The HomeView interface intelligently adjusts based on the user’s distance, showing simpler information that’s viewable from across the room and richer detail as they step closer. A separate wall-mounted HomeView model — available in space gray and silver — offers the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display, powerful set of features, and rich audio. It can be attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation. HomeView recognizes up to six people and delivers a personalized experience for each one. Each user gets their own personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests. HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon. Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic and get an answer. With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information from Messages and Calendar, playlists on Apple Music, and more by drawing on their personal context. Users have the ability to customize the expressiveness and pace of Siri’s voice on their paired and compatible device so that it’s just right for them. That customization carries over to HomeView, allowing users to go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before.3 Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, which uses iCloud to privately sync history across a user’s products, so they can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro. With Siri AI built into HomeView, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; ability to have rich, natural conversations; and improved music discovery.
With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI does more for each person — taking action across apps and surfacing relevant information by drawing on each user’s personal context.
Conversations that start on HomeView seamlessly continue in the Siri app, so users can pick up the conversation on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, or Apple Vision Pro.

With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant. Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background. By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments. HomeView offers an exceptional listening experience through a custom-engineered acoustic system. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio. A down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base, offering incredible bass extension. Powered by Apple silicon and real-time system sensors, advanced computational audio continuously optimizes loudness and bass response at any volume. The wall-mounted version delivers rich sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement. HomeView is the perfect way to enjoy Apple Music, complete with animated album art and lyrics, as well as Apple Podcasts, Apple News,4 Apple TV, and compatible third-party audio and video apps.5 With Handoff, users can continue listening to a song they were playing in the car or on a walk by placing their iPhone in front of the HomeView display. By setting up multiple HomeView, HomePod, HomePod mini, and AirPlay-compatible speakers around the house, users can enjoy music throughout the entire home with multiroom audio. HomeView makes it effortless for users to stay in touch and get things done around the house. FaceTime and Center Stage keep everyone framed perfectly, even when participants are moving around the room.6 Messages can be read and answered by voice or with the onscreen keyboard. Intercom lets users broadcast a quick message to a single room or the whole house — reaching other HomeView and HomePod speakers, as well as personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. In the kitchen, HomeView is the perfect sous chef, converting recipes from the web into step-by-step instructions with hands-free timer control and help with ingredient tracking, so users can stay focused on what’s cooking.
HomeView makes it easy for users to communicate and get things done around the house, whether they’re hopping on a FaceTime call, looking up a recipe, or setting a timer hands-free.
HomeView makes it easy for users to communicate and get things done around the house, whether they’re hopping on a FaceTime call, looking up a recipe, or setting a timer hands-free.
HomeView makes it easy for users to communicate and get things done around the house, whether they’re hopping on a FaceTime call, looking up a recipe, or setting a timer hands-free.

With Find My, users can check in on loved ones who have shared their locations with them, or track down a misplaced iPhone, AirPods charging case, or personal item with an AirTag attached. And with Live Activities, HomeView surfaces timely, at-a-glance information, like the song that’s currently playing, an active timer, or an incoming Intercom message from another room. HomeView allows users to securely control their smart home by touch or with just their voice using Siri AI — viewing camera feeds, adjusting the thermostat and lights, locking doors, or closing the blinds. The Home Modular face offers instant access to users’ favorite accessories, while the Home Camera face can livestream up to nine video feeds at once, letting users keep an eye on doorstep deliveries and pets playing in the yard. With a supported iCloud+ subscription, HomeView works with compatible cameras to deliver intelligent, end-to-end encrypted recognition of people, familiar faces, pets, packages, and vehicles, notifying the household the moment someone arrives at the front door. With video descriptions for HomeKit Secure Video footage, HomeView helps users quickly understand what happened in a video clip without even watching it.7 Offering added peace of mind, HomeView also detects the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and alerts users on their iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. HomeView also works with Apple Home Collection — a new lineup of smart home cameras, thermostats, and a lock designed in collaboration with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric — as well as other Works with Apple Home and Matter accessories.8 Together, they help users understand what’s happening inside and outside, manage access, keep the home at just the right temperature, and so much more.9 Like every Apple product, HomeView was built with privacy and security at its core. HomeView and the A18 chip include Secure Exclaves: protected and compartmentalized runtimes used to process camera and microphone data separately from the rest of the system. Isolation features added across many core components of the silicon work in tandem to protect Secure Exclaves and keep them segregated from the rest of the system. Data that is processed and analyzed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple. To ensure that personal content stays private to each individual, even when HomeView is shared by the whole household, content in apps like Messages and Calendar is only surfaced when the enrolled user is recognized by their face, and when their paired iPhone or iPad is present and has been recently unlocked.10 Siri requests on HomeView can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored nor made accessible to Apple or anyone else. HomeView was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomeView is made with 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure base and in the enclosure of the wall-mounted model, 100 percent recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards, and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets. HomeView meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based11 and designed to be recycled. Pricing and Availability

Customers in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, the UK, and the U.S. can pre-order Apple HomeView in silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray for $299 (U.S.), and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) in space gray and silver for $299 (U.S.), starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app. Customers in Singapore can pre-order starting Thursday, October 15, at 9 a.m. SGT. Both models will be available in these countries beginning Friday, November 13. Customers in South Africa will be able to pre-order Apple HomeView and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) through Apple Authorized Resellers, with availability beginning Friday, November 13. Apple HomeView is not available for sale in the European Union, as Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. Apple is working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.

HomeView (Wall Mounted) will be available with a choice of three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home. Power Mount USB‑C Wall Connector, available starting at $59.95 (U.S.), and Power Mount AC Wired, available starting at $79.95 (U.S.), can be ordered starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app. Power Mount PoE Wired will be available starting in early 2027 for $129.95 (U.S.).

units.text: Earlier today, Apple confirmed that the wall-mounted HomeView does not come with a power adapter in the box.
Now, the company has published a support document detailing the device’s power requirements, including what to look for when purchasing a compatible adapter. Here are the details.
Important information for HomeView (Wall Mounted) buyers
If you’re buying the wall-mounted version of the new Apple HomeView, Apple has published a new support article with some important information.
As the company announced earlier today, the HomeView (Wall Mounted) model does not include a mount, nor does it come with a power adapter in the box.

This means that users will need to buy those separately. As my colleague Ryan explained earlier today, “Apple is selling two different mount options that start at $59, and it says a third is coming in early 2027.”

As for the power adapter, Apple explains in a new support article that the wall-mounted HomeView requires a USB-C power adapter rated for at least 20W, with support for 9V at 2.22A or higher. If those requirements aren’t met, the device may display a “Not Enough Power” warning.
Alternatively, depending on the third-party mount, the wall-mounted HomeView can be connected directly to a home’s electrical wiring without a separate USB-C power adapter.
Here’s Apple:

HomeView ships with a power cable and adapter. HomeView (Wall Mounted) requires a compatible third-party mount and power solution for operation, sold separately. Depending on the mount, you can use a separate power cable and adapter or connect to line power (hardwired).
HomeView: Use a USB-C cable and a USB-C power adapter that’s at least 30W and supports 15V at 2A or higher.
HomeView (Wall Mounted): Use a USB-C cable and a USB-C power adapter (both sold separately) that’s at least 20W and supports 9V at 2.22A or higher.
Apple also links to a compatible power adapter for HomeView or HomeView (Wall Mounted), and details the troubleshooting process for a HomeView showing a “Not Enough Power” message.
To read Apple’s support article in full, follow this link.

units.text: Beats is teaming up with The Pokémon Company for a special-edition version of the Beats Pill. Beats says this collab is “here to unleash the energy of your music, inspired by the power of Pikachu’s brightest spark and the depths of Mimikyu’s mystery.”
Here’s how Beats describes the Pokémon-infused design of this special-edition Beats Pill:

Featuring both beloved Pokémon on its grill, the front and back of the speaker incorporate the unmistakable electric yellow of Pikachu and a grayscale interpretation of the mysterious Mimikyu. This is the first time Beats has released a Pill with charms. The speaker comes with bespoke Pokémon charms including the iconic Poké Ball and the Beats “b” logo, as well as lightning bolts — a signature symbol for Pikachu. The special-edition Pill also features its own playfully interactive packaging design.
Here’s Chris Thorne, Beats CMO:

“Pokémon Trainers are some of the most passionate in the world, and we saw an opportunity to channel that energy into something fun, unexpected, and created especially for fans. This collaboration unites two brands rooted in culture, giving fans a new way to express their love of Pokémon through sound.”

Other than that one-of-a-kind design, this is the same Beats Pill we’ve come to know and love. Beats revitalized the Beats Pill back in 2024 with better Apple integration, USB-C, 24 hours of battery life, and more. You can read my full review for all the details.

The new Pokémon x Beats Pill collab will be available to order starting October 15 for $149.99. In the United States, you can order it from Apple and Target. Shoppers in the UK can order from Apple and Argos. In China, it will be available from Douyin.
Learn more about the collab and sign up for launch details on the Beats website.

Apple today announced a new HomePod mini equipped with Siri AI, new colors, and improved audio experiences. The new ‌HomePod‌ mini has an S10 chip that supports advanced computational audio, and Apple says it optimizes dynamic range, loudness, and acoustic performance in real-time.

A Sound Glow feature turns the ‌HomePod‌ mini's top into a "visual canvas" that glows and animates in sync with music, reacting to bass and treble. It uses colors generated from the song's album artwork for a unique experience for each song.

evidence.title: Will HomeView support third-party apps? Here’s what Apple says - 9to5Mac

units.text: Apple today announced HomeView, a $299 smart home display with a 7-inch screen that lets users control connected accessories, make FaceTime calls, and enjoy music and video content. But what about third-party apps? Here’s what Apple says.
Apple HomeView’s support for third-party apps will be limited
Apple says the new HomeView smart home display is “designed for life at home,” with a wide range of features for managing connected accessories, staying organized, and enjoying entertainment.
That includes everything from controlling smart home devices and checking calendars to watching videos, listening to music, and making FaceTime calls.
However, one question Apple’s announcement didn’t fully answer is the extent to which HomeView will support third-party apps.

According to Apple, in addition to a selection of Apple apps, including Music, Podcasts, and Safari, HomeView will also support “compatible third-party audio and video apps from your iPhone for a familiar experience across devices.”
Interestingly, the fine print for this feature differs between Apple’s HomeView marketing page and the product’s press release.
While the produt page says:
Subscription may be required to access some content and services. Some applications are not available in all areas.
The press release, however, includes an additional detail (emphasis ours):
Subscription may be required to access some content and services. Some applications are not available in all areas. Select apps require a paired and compatible iPhone nearby.
Some of Apple’s own first-party apps will also be available from the iPhone, the company notes. That includes Audiobooks, Apple Music Classical, News, and TV.
Apple has yet to detail how the iPhone proximity requirement will work, and whether developers of apps in supported categories will need to take any additional steps to support HomeView.
View all comments

According ot Wired, “a handful of third-party media apps like Spotify are available, and developers can bring over existing CarPlay apps.” Wired adds that “if your iPhone already has one of these CarPlay apps installed, it can automatically appear on the HomeView after setup.”

So it looks like HomeView’s third-party app support will rely on the existing CarPlay framework, rather than requiring developers to build apps specifically for the device. It remains unclear, though, whether this will extend to other CarPlay app categories, such as communication and AI assistants, or also be limited to media apps.
We have reached out to Apple for clarification on how third-party app support will work, and will update this post if we hear back.
Are you getting an Apple HomeView? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.raw_lead: Following a teaser yesterday, Apple's Beats brand has now officially announced its latest collaboration, this time with The Pokémon Company International for a special-edition Beats Pill speaker featuring Pikachu and Mimikyu on the speaker's grill. The Pokémon x Beats Pill launches this Thursday, October 15, and it will be available at the same $149.99 price as other Beats Pill variants.
evidence.title: Beats and Pokémon Team Up for Special-Edition Beats Pill Speaker

units.text: Beats and Pokémon Team Up for Special-Edition Beats Pill Speaker

Following a teaser yesterday, Apple's Beats brand has now officially announced its latest collaboration, this time with The Pokémon Company International for a special-edition Beats Pill speaker featuring Pikachu and Mimikyu on the speaker's grill. The Pokémon x Beats Pill launches this Thursday, October 15, and it will be available at the same $149.99 price as other Beats Pill variants.

Aside from the Pokémon artwork, the speaker is otherwise a standard Beats Pill with a gray body and grill, although it does also come with bespoke Pokémon charms including a Poke Ball, the Beats "b" logo, and Pikachu's signature lightning bolts.

"Pokémon Trainers are some of the most passionate in the world, and we saw an opportunity to channel that energy into something fun, unexpected, and created especially for fans," said Chris Thorne, Beats CMO. "This collaboration unites two brands rooted in culture, giving fans a new way to express their love of Pokémon through sound."

Like other Beats Pill models, the Pokémon x Beats Pill features up to 24 hours of battery life, IP67 dust and water resistance, and the ability to wirelessly pair two Beats Pills together in Amplify Mode or Stereo Mode, output lossless audio when connected to a source via USB-C, and charge compatible phones from the speaker's USB-C port.
Beats Pill x Pokémon: Pikachu & Mimikyu | Official FilmBeats by Dre
Watch on YouTube

Sales of the Pokémon x Beats Pill will be limited to the United States, United Kingdom, and China, with availability only through Apple's website in all three countries, Target (online and select stores) in the United States, Argos (online and select stores) in the United Kingdom, and Douyin in China.

units.text: Apple unveiled its new HomeView product today, and it’s available for pre-order now. But unfortunately HomeView isn’t coming to the EU, at least for now. Here’s why.
Apple cites Siri AI’s absence from iOS as reason why it can’t launch HomeView in EU
Today Apple launched its Siri AI-centric ‘HomeView’ smart display product.
But if you’re in the EU, you can’t order one yet. And that’s not a mistake or oversight.
Per Apple’s press release:
Apple HomeView is not available for sale in the European Union, as Siri AI is currently unavailable in iOS in the EU. Apple is working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.
View all comments
It’s a surprising decision, since presumably Apple could launch HomeView with Siri AI in the EU—just not with support for features that tie in with iOS 27.
Siri AI is available with macOS Golden Gate and visionOS 27 in the EU, for example. That’s because macOS and visionOS aren’t deemed gatekeeper platforms the way iOS is by the Digital Markets Act.

If Apple did launch HomeView in the EU, it would likely need to disable certain personal context features related to Siri AI. And it seems the company believes a compromised experience like that wouldn’t be worth it. So it’s holding out until Siri AI is able to come to iPhone users in the EU.
What do you make of Apple’s decision to not launch HomeView in the EU? Let us know in the comments.

evidence.discovery_lead: Apple already denies European users Siri AI because of regulatory disputes, but now for the first time its hardware is being affected with no EU release for the HomeView . HomeView is a hardware Siri AI device, and Siri AI is not available in the EU - image credit: Apple. The short version is that the European Union's Digital Markets Act (DMA) requires Apple to provide rivals with full access to its technology from day one. Apple argues that no other firm has this burden, and moreover that it dramatically compromises users' privacy. This is why users in the EU have not had features ranging from iPhone Mirroring and Mac Live Activities, to Siri AI . And it's now why they will not get the new HomeView, at least not at first, and possibly not ever. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

units.text: New Apple TV 4K Announced With A19 Chip, Updated Siri Remote, More

Apple today announced the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K, with key features including an A19 chip, Siri AI support, an updated Siri Remote that has Find My support with Precision Finding, built in far-field microphones, support for surround sound with four HomePods in front and rear pairs, and more.

The A19 chip in the new Apple TV 4K delivers up to 50% faster CPU performance and up to twice as fast graphics performance compared to the previous-generation model with the A15 Bionic chip, according to Apple. With the A19 chip, the Apple TV likely has an increased 8GB of RAM as well, up from 4GB in the previous model.

The more personalized and intelligent Siri AI powered by Apple Intelligence is now on Apple TV. The new Apple TV 4K has three far-field microphones that allow users to talk to Siri AI in a hands-free manner, but the updated Siri Remote still has a microphone and a Siri button on its side if you prefer to use the assistant that way.

For example, Apple said users can simply ask Siri which Apple TV shows won at the Emmy Awards this year and see poster art pulled directly from the Apple TV app, along with relevant suggestions like "more award-winning comedies."

Siri AI support does not require the new model. According to Apple, it is available in beta on the Apple TV 4K (2nd generation) and later running an upcoming tvOS 27.2 beta. At launch, Siri AI on the Apple TV will be limited to English in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the U.K.
Siri AI on the Apple TV requires a paired iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence for requests that involve a user's personal context.

As for the far-field microphones, Apple explained that "advanced echo cancellation intelligently isolates a user's voice from background sound to deliver crystal-clear 'Hey Siri' or 'Siri' recognition, even while audio is playing."
Far-field Siri is supported when tvOS is set to English, Mandarin Chinese, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hebrew, Norwegian, or Swedish.

Beyond the microphones and the status light now being centered on the front of the Apple TV 4K, there are no other obvious external design changes compared to the previous model. A future teardown will reveal internal changes.
The new Apple TV 4K: The ultimate cinematic experience.Apple
Watch on YouTube

The updated Siri Remote now supports the Precision Finding feature in the Find My app, making it easier to find. The remote now has a speaker built into it, allowing you to play a sound through the Find My app to help with locating it. The remote's overall design has not changed, and it still has a USB-C charging port.

For the first time, users can create a four-speaker surround sound experience with the new Apple TV 4K and the new HomePod mini 2 and the existing second-generation full-sized HomePod. You can have HomePod mini 2 speakers in front-left, front-right, rear-left, and right-right positions, or you can mix and match HomePod mini and HomePod speakers, so long as the front and rear pairs match. For example, you could have two full-sized HomePods up front and two HomePod mini 2 speakers in the rear.

The new Apple TV 4K can be pre-ordered starting today and launches on Friday, November 13. In the U.S., pricing is set at $299, with only a single configuration available now with 128GB of storage, Wi-Fi 7 support, and a Gigabit Ethernet port. The device is also equipped with a rear HDMI 2.1 port and supports Bluetooth 6.

units.text: New Apple TV 4K Adds Far-Field Microphones for Hands-Free Siri
Apple's new fourth-generation Apple TV 4K includes three built-in far-field microphones, allowing users to find something to watch and control playback without picking up the Siri Remote.

Users can activate the voice assistant by saying "Hey ‌Siri‌" or "‌Siri‌," including while a movie or TV show is playing. Apple says advanced echo cancellation separates the user's voice from background sound, helping the device recognize requests over the TV's audio.

The microphones also enable hands-free control of compatible smart home accessories and scenes. With ‌Siri‌ AI, users can search for entertainment conversationally and ask follow-up questions about what they are watching, with answers appearing in a compact overlay over the video.

Apple says the new Apple TV 4K and its A19 chip include Secure Exclaves, which are protected processing environments that handle microphone data separately from the rest of the system. According to Apple, data processed and analyzed inside these environments cannot be accessed by tvOS, apps, users, or Apple itself.

Far-field ‌Siri‌ support varies by region and language. The feature is supported when the primary tvOS language is set to English, Mandarin Chinese, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hebrew, Norwegian, or Swedish.
The new ‌Apple TV‌ 4K is available to preorder today for $299 in the United States, with availability beginning November 13.

units.text: Apple today officially unveiled its new HomeView smart display. HomeView features a 7-inch square display and comes in two versions: one with a speaker base and another for wall mounting.
You can pre-order HomeView today for $299. It will start arriving to customers on November 13.
Here’s everything you need to know about HomeView.
Apple HomeView: Features, specs, price, and more

HomeView features a 7-inch Liquid Retina display that’s connected to a domed speaker base with a stainless steel hinge with tilt support. The display features Apple’s True Tone technology and 500 nits of brightness. It can also dim to 0.3 nits, making it great for a nightstand.

There’s also a separate wall-mounted version of HomeView. This model can be “attached to a wall using three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home, with options for self-installation or professional installation.”
Here are the details on those wall-mounting options from Apple:

HomeView (Wall Mounted) will be available with a choice of three purpose-built mounts from Schneider Home. Power Mount USB‑C Wall Connector, available starting at $59.95 (U.S.), and Power Mount AC Wired, available starting at $79.95 (U.S.), can be ordered starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app. Power Mount PoE Wired will be available starting in early 2027 for $129.95 (U.S.).

Apple says the HomeView interface will intelligently adjust based on how far away you are. It will show “simpler information that’s viewable from across the room” as well as “richer detail” as you step closer.

HomeView can also recognize up to six different people and deliver a “personalized experience” for each one. This includes a personalized Home Screen with apps and widgets. “Personal content stays private from others, while shared photo albums and music can be easily enjoyed by everyone in a household, including guests,” Apple says.
There is a collection of “playful and informative” faces for HomeView:

Users can personalize HomeView with a collection of playful and informative faces that display information at a glance, taking full advantage of the vibrant Liquid Retina display. The Photos face brings cherished memories to life with stunning Portrait-style depth effects that keep the subject sharp while creating a beautifully blurred foreground and background.

By selecting a shared album, users can turn HomeView into a living photo frame that loved ones near and far can help fill. The Flow face dynamically responds to physical presence and movement, transforming HomeView into a piece of interactive art. And even Snoopy comes to life on HomeView, with animations that reflect the time of day, the weather, sporting events, and holiday moments.

HomeView supports Siri AI. Apple says that users with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad can tap into personal context. Users without an Apple Intelligence-capable device can still use Siri AI on HomeView for world knowledge and music discovery.
For audio quality, Apple says HomeView has a “custom-engineered acoustic system” with two full-range drivers in the display, plus a down-firing woofer and two force-canceling passive radiators.
Here are some more HomeView tidbits:
It has a Center Stage camera for FaceTime calls.
There’s a “Home Modular” face that gives easy access to smart home accessories. The “Home Camera” face can livestream up to nine video feeds at once.
HomeView isn’t available in the European Union because Siri AI isn’t available there either. Apple says it is “working constructively with the EU in an attempt to find a path forward.”

The table-top version of HomeView is available in silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray. The wall-mounted version is available in space gray and silver. You can pre-order both today for $299, with availability beginning November 13.
What do you think of Apple’s new HomeView? Are you going to order? Let us know down in the comments.

不过需要注意的是，壁挂版并不附带支架，用户需要另行购买。目前，苹果官网已经上架施耐德制造的三款安装支架，IT之家附具体详情如下：
Power Mount USB-C 壁挂式连接器：59.95 美元（现汇率约合 402 元人民币）
Power Mount AC：79.95 美元（现汇率约合 536.1 元人民币）
Power Mount PoE：129.95 美元（现汇率约合 871.4 元人民币），预计 2027 年初推出

units.text: Apple announced its HomeView smart display this morning. Apple says HomeView can recognize up to six different people to deliver a “personalized experience” for each user.
John Gruber at Daring Fireball has more details on how HomeView’s facial recognition feature works.
HomeView’s face recognition support

According to Gruber, a user must have a “registered personal device” with Apple Intelligence support in order to be “recognized” by HomeView. That device must be on the home’s Wi-Fi network and have been “recently unlocked.”

Your first question might be how this facial recognition to identify users works, using a Center Stage camera alone, when other products (like, notably, the iPhone Duo) don’t let you unlock using the camera alone. HomeView does not have FaceID. I asked about this and Apple reps said that first, your home is (reasonably!) presumed to be a safe space. But in order for users to be recognized — by voice or face — they must have a “registered personal device” that supports Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, that device must be present on the home’s Wi-Fi network, and it must have been recently unlocked.
Gruber also points to a footnote from the HomeView press release, which reads:
Personal context requests require a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad running the latest software version with Siri AI turned on and set to a supported language.
This means the Apple Watch does not count as a “registered personal device” for facial recognition on HomeView.
HomeView is available to pre-order today for $299 and will be released on November 13.

evidence.title: 苹果：Siri AI 将支持 Apple TV 4K 第二代、第三代

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果今天宣布推出第四代 Apple TV 4K，采用 A19 芯片，支持 Siri AI。
IT之家注意到，苹果今天还为老机用户带来了好消息：第二代、第三代的 Apple TV 4K 也能用上 Siri AI。
苹果官方在新闻稿表示：“Siri AI 将以测试版形式登陆第二代及更新款 Apple TV 4K，正式推出时支持美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、印度、新西兰、新加坡、南非和英国的英语用户。”
作为参考，Apple TV 4K （第二代）发布于 2021 年，采用 A12 仿生芯片，提供 32GB/64GB 容量；Apple TV 4K（第三代）发布于 2022 年，配备 A15 仿生芯片，与 USB-C 充电的 Siri Remote，Wi-Fi 版提供 64GB 容量，Wi-Fi+ 以太网版为 128GB。

Inside, the new model uses the A19 chip, up from the A15 Bionic introduced in October 2022. units.text: 苹果公司将于当地时间10月13日启动新一轮产品发布，重点转向智能家居领域。此次发布预计将带来一款全新的智能家居中枢设备、升级版Apple TV 4K以及新一代HomePod mini。其中，最受关注的是一款配备触摸屏、能够整合家庭设备控制和人工智能助手功能的全新产品，苹果希望借此进一步扩大其在智能家居市场的影响力。
与苹果传统上通过大型主题演讲集中发布新品的方式不同，此次活动预计不会采用常规的现场直播发布会形式。苹果已邀请部分媒体和内容创作者前往纽约参加名为“Welcome Home”的特别体验活动，参与者将有机会现场体验新产品。其他用户则可能通过苹果新闻稿和官方视频了解新品信息。
苹果全球营销高级副总裁格雷格·乔斯维亚克此前公布了此次活动的预告信息。“Welcome Home”这一主题暗示，新产品将主要围绕家庭场景展开。结合此前多方披露的信息，苹果此次发布的核心将是重新设计智能家居体验，并让Siri人工智能助手在家庭设备控制中发挥更重要的作用。
此次最引人关注的新品，是一款此前已经传闻多时的智能家居中枢。该设备的定位介于iPad与HomePod之间，预计配备约6英寸的方形触摸屏，既可以安装在墙壁上，也可以放置在桌面或厨房台面上。
根据此前曝光的信息，这款设备可能采用类似iMac G4的半球形扬声器底座设计，屏幕通过支架与底座连接；另一个版本则面向墙面安装场景。用户可以根据家庭布局选择不同的安装方式，在客厅、厨房或其他房间设置多个设备。
这款智能家居中枢的核心功能，是将家庭成员的信息、日程安排、智能设备控制和多媒体内容整合到一个界面中。设备预计能够显示日历事件、天气、时间以及各种应用和小组件，并允许用户通过触摸屏或语音指令控制兼容的智能家居设备。
摄像头和存在感应器也是其设计中的重要组成部分。设备预计能够识别附近是否有人，并根据不同家庭成员显示个性化界面。通过面部识别等功能，它有望区分不同用户，展示各自的日程、提醒和其他个人信息。
这意味着，苹果希望将智能家居中枢从一个单纯的设备控制面板，发展为家庭成员日常生活中的信息入口。用户不必每次都拿出iPhone打开家庭应用，就可以查看日程、控制灯光和其他智能设备，或者通过语音向Siri提出问题。
人工智能将是这款产品的重要卖点。苹果此前一直在推进Siri能力升级，而智能家居中枢被认为是展示新一代Siri的重要平台。与传统语音助手主要执行固定指令不同，升级后的Siri预计将更加注重理解用户意图、处理自然语言请求，并协助完成多步骤任务。
例如，用户可能希望通过语音询问当天的日程、调整家庭设备设置，或者获取与家庭活动有关的信息。苹果希望通过人工智能改善这些交互过程，让用户不必记住特定指令，也不必频繁在不同应用之间切换。
不过，新设备的实际智能化水平仍有待正式发布后验证。此前，Apple Intelligence家居中枢的推出时间曾受到Siri升级进度影响，因此，新产品能否提供稳定、实用且具有明显优势的人工智能体验，将直接影响它的市场表现。
在价格方面，此前的传闻预计，这款智能家居中枢的起售价可能在350美元左右。如果最终定价接近这一水平，它将明显高于普通智能音箱，也高于部分入门级智能显示设备。苹果显然希望通过更完整的软硬件整合、个性化服务和生态系统优势，为这款产品建立更高端的定位。
除全新智能家居中枢外，苹果预计还将推出升级版Apple TV 4K。这一产品线已经有近四年没有迎来全面更新，因此此次升级也受到长期用户关注。
新款Apple TV预计将采用更新的处理器，可能搭载A19或A19 Pro芯片，并增加运行内存。此前的消息指出，新设备的内存容量可能达到8GB或12GB，具体配置仍有待苹果正式确认。
增加处理器性能和内存容量，不仅能够改善应用运行速度，也可能为更复杂的Siri功能和Apple Intelligence相关体验提供支持。如果苹果希望让Apple TV从传统的流媒体播放设备进一步发展为家庭智能中枢，更强的计算能力将有助于其承担更多任务。
新款Apple TV预计还将采用苹果自研的N1无线连接芯片，支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6.0。与现有型号相比，新无线芯片有望改善网络连接能力，并降低部分使用场景下的延迟。不过，实际网络性能仍取决于路由器、网络环境和具体应用。
外观方面，目前的传闻没有显示新款Apple TV会进行大幅重新设计。其主体外形可能继续沿用现有产品的紧凑型黑色机身，变化主要集中在内部硬件和配套遥控器上。
Siri Remote也可能迎来调整。此前苹果软件中出现了与新遥控器有关的线索，但具体变化尚不清楚。遥控器的升级可能围绕操作便利性、语音交互或设备定位等功能展开，最终设计仍有待发布确认。
另一款预计亮相的产品是新一代HomePod mini。自2020年推出以来，这款小型智能音箱一直是苹果家庭音频产品线的重要组成部分，但其硬件已经显得相对陈旧。此次更新预计不会彻底改变外观，而是主要升级内部处理器、无线连接能力和颜色选择。
新款HomePod mini预计将采用性能更强的处理器，以支持升级后的Siri功能。与智能家居中枢类似，它也可能更加注重自然语言交互和家庭设备控制，让用户通过语音完成更多操作。
无线连接方面，新产品预计采用N1芯片，支持Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙6以及Thread相关功能。Thread是一种面向智能家居设备的低功耗网络技术，能够帮助兼容设备建立稳定的连接。随着智能家居设备数量不断增加，更完善的无线连接能力有望改善不同设备之间的协作体验。
新款HomePod mini还可能增加新的外观颜色，包括此前传闻中的粉色和绿色等选择。对于现有用户而言，这些变化虽然不如全新智能家居中枢那样具有颠覆性，但更强的处理器和无线连接能力仍可能延长产品的使用价值。
苹果此次发布还处于其智能家居战略调整的重要阶段。过去十年，苹果已经推出Home应用、HomePod智能音箱以及HomeKit相关功能，但在智能家居市场中，其表现一直受到亚马逊Echo和GoogleHome等竞争产品的挑战。
其中一个原因是，智能家居设备的配置过程对普通消费者而言仍然比较复杂。不同品牌的设备在连接方式、功能支持和控制体验方面存在差异，用户需要花费时间完成设置，并在多个应用之间切换。与此同时，Siri过去在理解复杂请求和提供开放式回答方面也存在一定局限。
人工智能能力的提升，有望帮助苹果改善这些问题。如果Siri能够更准确地理解用户意图，并将语音请求与家庭设备控制、个人信息和应用功能结合起来，智能家居中枢就可能成为连接苹果生态系统与家庭生活的重要节点。
不过，苹果仍然需要解决第三方设备兼容性的问题。智能家居市场涉及大量不同厂商和产品，如果新设备主要围绕苹果自身生态运行，而无法方便地接入其他品牌的智能门锁、摄像头、恒温器和照明设备，那么它的吸引力仍可能受到限制。
因此，此次发布的意义不仅在于推出几款新硬件，也在于苹果能否借助人工智能和新的家庭交互方式，真正改善智能家居产品的使用体验。
值得注意的是，苹果预计不会在10月13日一次性公布所有2026年剩余新品。此前的消息显示，公司还计划在10月下旬进行第二轮产品发布，重点转向Mac和iPad产品线。

units.text: Apple has officially announced the new HomePod mini 2 smart speaker. The new product was announced by Apple today alongside the new HomeView smart display and fourth-gen Apple TV 4K.
HomePod mini 2 now available to pre-order

HomePod mini 2 features the same design as the original version. It comes in a variety of refreshed and returning color options: green, pink, blue, midnight, and white. It replaces the dated S5 chip with a new S10 chip to deliver new features and experiences.
Siri AI and Sound Glow are new to HomePod mini 2
Apple says the new HomePod mini 2 will work with Siri AI, Apple’s upgraded version of the personal assistant that debuted with iOS 27.
Powered by an entirely new architecture built on the latest generation of Apple Foundation Models, Siri AI transforms the HomePod mini experience and helps users get more done than ever before.
When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, HomePod mini can tap into a user’s personal context to help them find what they need in the moment.
HomePod mini 2 also includes a new hardware feature called Sound Glow:

With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini transforms into a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with the music, reacting in real time to bass and treble. The song’s album artwork from Now Playing generates a color-matched light experience that’s unique to every song, and users can pick a soundscape like rain to trigger bespoke animations for a soothing atmosphere.
HomePod mini 2 can create a home theater experience
When paired with the new Apple TV 4K (fourth-gen), a pair of HomePod mini 2 speakers and a pair of full-size HomePod 2 speakers can create a new home theater experience as well:

HomePod mini delivers rich 360-degree sound from its compact footprint, whether it’s used as a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or as part of a multiroom audio setup. Powered by the Apple S10 chip and advanced computational audio, it analyzes music in real time to optimize dynamic range, loudness, and acoustic performance. For the first time, users can create a four-speaker surround sound experience with Apple TV 4K (4th generation) and HomePod mini 2. Together, the four speakers and the new Apple TV 4K intelligently recognize each speaker’s position in the room, so audio timing and levels are automatically calibrated to the space.
Price and availability

Pre-orders start today ahead of the launch on October 30. The price is $149. Apple says it will run “HomePod software 27.2.” Apple adds that Siri AI will come in a future software update, suggesting it may not be available at launch.
The original HomePod mini was released in November 2020 for $99. Apple increased the price to $129 earlier this year.

units.text: Today Apple unveiled the long-awaited new Apple TV 4K model, which includes an updated Siri Remote with a built-in speaker as part of its Find My and Precision Finding support. But even if you’re not upgrading, you can still buy the new Siri Remote for your current Apple TV.
New Siri Remote available for $59 with Precision Finding and built-in speaker
Are you always losing your Siri Remote for Apple TV? Then you might be interested in the new Siri Remote that comes with the fourth-gen Apple TV 4K.
The new Apple TV 4K is available to pre-order now and ships November 13. But its $299 price tag may put off prospective upgraders.
If you just want the new Siri Remote, you can order that instead.
From Apple’s press release:
The new Siri Remote is compatible with Apple TV HD and Apple TV 4K, and is also available for purchase separately.
The latest Siri Remote has the same basic design as the prior model. But it adds Precision Finding support for Find My, and a built-in speaker so you can play a sound on the remote when it’s lost.
Precision Finding will be a significant upgrade when trying to recover your lost remote, as it can guide you directly to the remote on your iPhone or Apple Watch.
You can order the Siri Remote (4th generation) from the Apple Store for $59.
The remote will ship to customers on November 13, the same day the new Apple TV 4K delivers.
Will you buy the new Siri Remote, or the fourth-gen Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，苹果正请求美国联邦法官撤销 Taction 科技提起的专利侵权诉讼中高达 57 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 382.19 亿元人民币）的判决，该案涉及 iPhone 与 Apple Watch 所搭载的 Taptic Engine 触觉引擎。
数周前，陪审团裁定苹果需支付 57 亿美元，理由是苹果侵犯了 Taction 科技持有的两项专利，这些专利和苹果设备实现触觉反馈的 Taptic Engine 技术相关。
当时苹果就表示，强烈反对陪审团的裁决与赔偿金额，称其“完全没有事实支撑”。
苹果强调，自家技术和 Taction 两项专利所覆盖的技术存在“根本性差异”，并宣布计划提起上诉。
今日，苹果提交了新的动议，请求法院撤销陪审团裁决。苹果主张，Taction 未能提供足够证据支撑任何赔偿，更不用说 57 亿美元的赔付金额。苹果指出，这一数额是“史上最高专利案件判决金额，超出此前纪录 30 多亿美元”。
苹果补充道，庭审前，法院就因为 Taction 的损害赔偿专家在依据过往许可协议计算专利费的方法存在缺陷，剔除了该专家的分析报告，之后这名专家更是被禁止出庭作证。
苹果还提出，Taction 从未拿出证据证明其专利技术的实际价值，只是简单请陪审员裁定他们认为合理的专利许可费，导致陪审员“只能进行大规模、不被允许的主观猜测”。
苹果在动议文件中写道：
Taction 向陪审团表示，“我们只想要针对我方技术贡献的合理专利费”，…… 但从未提供证据说明这项贡献价值多少。相反，它只是请求陪审团“裁定你们认为合适的合理专利费”。…… Taction 未能完成举证义务，无法提供证据让陪审团“将赔偿金额和侵权行为充分关联起来”。…… 缺少这类证据，陪审团只能进行推测，这违背了法官的庭审指引，也违反联邦巡回上诉法院的判例。
苹果还提到，在赔偿金额宣布之前，法官曾对代理律师表示，他“不确定裁决表上的数字是不是陪审团想要表达的结果”，这让人质疑 57 亿美元这个数字是否真的是陪审团的本意。
苹果提出一项更为严厉的指控：Taction 的核心技术专家奥利弗博士（Dr. Oliver）依靠一套“人为操纵”的测试，得出专利侵权结论。
简单来说，涉案两项 Taction 专利描述的技术，目标是在不同频率下输出稳定振动。苹果主张，其 Taptic Engine 的工作原理并不相同，在部分频率下振动强度会远高于其他频率。
苹果进一步指控，奥利弗博士专门为这起诉讼开发了一套全新检测方法，这套方法衡量的是苹果电子控制系统调节 Taptic Engine 振动的能力，而非底层硬件是否满足专利要求。
文件原文摘录：
任何理性陪审员，都无法依据法院的专利权利要求解释，认定被控产品中的“换能器输出为高阻尼状态”。Taction 的侵权判定依据，没有使用专利记载的测试方法，而是建立在奥利弗博士为本案专门设计、存在法律错误且经过人为操纵的测试之上。能够反映换能器真实输出的证据，包括 Taction 起诉前和侵权主张阶段开展的测试，全部由苹果提交。这些测试显示输出存在峰值响应，奥利弗博士本人也承认这不属于高阻尼输出。
最后苹果提出，如果采信 Taction 对专利的解读，涉案专利权利要求本身就是无效的。苹果认为，用于判定侵权的测试方法，和专利文件描述的方法互相矛盾，无法清晰界定专利实际保护范围。
基于以上理由，苹果请求法院撤销陪审团裁决，判定 Taction 无权获得任何赔偿，认定苹果没有侵犯这些（效力存疑的）专利。若法院不支持该请求，苹果则要求重新开庭，就侵权认定、专利有效性和赔偿金额进行新一轮审理。
苹果的动议现已提交，陪审团裁决尚未正式生效为最终判决。法院接下来将进行审议，决定维持这 57 亿美元赔偿、撤销裁决，或是下令重审。

units.text: 苹果旗下音频品牌Beats正式公布与宝可梦（Pokémon）的全新联名合作产品，推出特别版Beats Pill蓝牙音箱。新产品以宝可梦系列最具代表性的角色皮卡丘和谜拟丘为设计主题，并将于10月15日正式上市。
此次联名款采用灰色机身设计，在音箱网罩位置加入了皮卡丘与谜拟丘的专属图案。皮卡丘以经典电气元素形象出现，而谜拟丘则以灰色风格呈现，形成鲜明视觉对比。整体设计在保持Beats Pill原有外观的基础上，增加了浓厚的宝可梦主题特色。
除了音箱本体之外，Beats还为这款产品设计了专属包装。包装采用互动式设计，能够展示角色耳朵等元素，使产品在开箱时具有更强的收藏和展示价值。
值得注意的是，这也是Beats首次为Pill系列产品加入挂绳饰品。随机附赠的挂件包括精灵球、皮卡丘标志性的闪电图案以及Beats经典“b”标识，进一步强化了联名产品身份。
在硬件规格方面，这款宝可梦特别版并未进行功能调整，仍然基于2024年重新推出的Beats Pill平台打造。产品配备升级后的音频系统，可提供更强劲的声音表现和低频效果，续航时间最长可达24小时，同时具备IP67级防尘防水能力。音箱兼容Android智能手机和iPhone，并支持通过USB-C连接播放无损音频。
皮卡丘作为自1996年宝可梦系列诞生以来最具代表性的角色之一，早已成为全球范围内辨识度最高的游戏形象之一。与之搭档的谜拟丘则是近年来人气迅速上升的宝可梦角色，其设定是一只披着仿制皮卡丘外衣的幽灵系宝可梦，希望借助皮卡丘的人气获得朋友，这种独特背景也使其深受粉丝喜爱。
业内认为，选择在10月推出同时包含谜拟丘元素的联名产品并非巧合。随着万圣节临近，具有神秘色彩的谜拟丘成为此次合作的重要视觉焦点，为产品增添了节日氛围。
该联名版Beats Pill将于10月15日正式发售，售价149美元，与标准版Beats Pill保持一致。产品将在苹果零售渠道及部分合作零售商同步上市，面向宝可梦粉丝和音频爱好者销售。

苹果旗下音频品牌Beats正式公布与宝可梦（Pokémon）的全新联名合作产品，推出特别版Beats Pill蓝牙音箱。新产品以宝可梦系列最具代表性的角色皮卡丘和谜拟丘为设计主题，并将于10月15日正式上市。
值得注意的是，这也是Beats首次为Pill系列产品加入挂绳饰品。随机附赠的挂件包括精灵球、皮卡丘标志性的闪电图案以及Beats经典“b”标识，进一步强化了联名产品身份。
在硬件规格方面，这款宝可梦特别版并未进行功能调整，仍然基于2024年重新推出的Beats Pill平台打造。产品配备升级后的音频系统，可提供更强劲的声音表现和低频效果，续航时间最长可达24小时，同时具备IP67级防尘防水能力。音箱兼容Android智能手机和iPhone，并支持通过USB-C连接播放无损音频。
皮卡丘作为自1996年宝可梦系列诞生以来最具代表性的角色之一，早已成为全球范围内辨识度最高的游戏形象之一。与之搭档的谜拟丘则是近年来人气迅速上升的宝可梦角色，其设定是一只披着仿制皮卡丘外衣的幽灵系宝可梦，希望借助皮卡丘的人气获得朋友，这种独特背景也使其深受粉丝喜爱。
业内认为，选择在10月推出同时包含谜拟丘元素的联名产品并非巧合。随着万圣节临近，具有神秘色彩的谜拟丘成为此次合作的重要视觉焦点，为产品增添了节日氛围。
该联名版Beats Pill将于10月15日正式发售，售价149美元，与标准版Beats Pill保持一致。产品将在苹果零售渠道及部分合作零售商同步上市，面向宝可梦粉丝和音频爱好者销售。

units.text: Today Apple unveiled HomeView, its long-awaited smart home hub. The HomeView comes in two distinct models, one with a domed speaker base and the other designed for wall mounting. But there’s a hidden feature difference beyond the form factors.
HomeView speaker system is much more powerful on model with domed base
If you’re trying to decide which HomeView form factor to buy, there’s a key detail you should know about.
Beyond the obvious design differences between the model with a domed base—‘HomeView’—and the one designed for your wall—‘HomeView (Wall Mounted)’—there’s a disparity in capabilities too.
The standard HomeView has a much more powerful speaker system built in. Here are Apple’s descriptions of each speaker setup:

HomeView delivers room-filling sound with support for Spatial Audio, making it a great way to enjoy music and podcasts at home. Its custom-engineered acoustic system combines a down-firing woofer and two full-range drivers to produce deep bass and crisp highs. Powered by the A18 chip and built-in sensors, computational audio continuously optimizes the loudness and bass response at any volume.
HomeView (Wall Mounted) brings full, balanced sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement, along with support for Spatial Audio.
Echoing this, Apple’s technical specs page confirms both models have two custom full-range drivers, but the HomeView with domed base adds:
Custom down-firing woofer
Dual force-cancelling passive radiators
Essentially, if you want the best sound experience from your HomeView, you’ll want to buy the standard model.

But if audio quality isn’t as important to you, the wall-mounted version will probably get the job done. It still has built-in speakers, but it won’t deliver the same performance and thus isn’t as well-suited for everyday music playback.
Does the difference in audio quality change your HomeView purchase decision at all? Let us know in the comments.

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果刚刚推出了全新的 Apple HomeView 智能家居管理设备，标准版与壁挂版定价均为 299 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,005 元人民币），首批上市国家（澳大利亚、加拿大、印度、新西兰、英国和美国）今日开启预购，后续新加坡于 10 月 15 日开启预购，均于 11 月 13 日正式开售。

该产品搭载 A18 芯片，配备 7 英寸（实际 6.98 英寸）Liquid Retina 显示屏（IPS 面板，1088×1088 像素分辨率，220ppi，支持原彩显示，自带防指纹疏油层），还配备了一颗 1200 万像素摄像头（ƒ/2.4 光圈），整合音乐播放、FaceTime 视频通话、家庭监控和智能家居控制等功能，并搭载基于 Apple Intelligence 的 Siri AI；支持 Wi-Fi 6E、蓝牙 6.0、Thread；需搭配运行 iOS 27.2 或更高版本的 iPhone 或运行 iPadOS 27.2 或更高版本的 iPad 使用。
苹果表示，该设备支持面部识别，可根据不同家庭成员切换个性化内容，同时将隐私与安全保护作为产品设计的核心。
这款设备可识别最多六位家庭成员并根据识别结果显示对应用户在信息、FaceTime、日历、提醒事项和“查找”等应用中的个人内容，同时支持全家共享照片相册和音乐。苹果表示，个人内容不会向其他家庭成员开放。
苹果全球营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 表示，HomeView“旨在被家中所有人共享，同时对每位用户而言都感觉完全个人化”。
HomeView 采用铝合金机身设计，屏幕通过不锈钢铰链与半球形扬声器底座连接，支持倾斜调节，提供银色、星光色、玫瑰粉和深空灰四种配色，附赠同色线缆。

壁挂版提供深空灰和银色两种选择，可通过 Schneider Home 的三款专用支架安装，支持自行安装或专业安装。在配套的 Schneider Home 支架中，Power Mount USB-C Wall Connector 起售价 59.95 美元（现汇率约合 402 元人民币），Power Mount AC Wired 起售价 79.95 美元（现汇率约合 536.1 元人民币），今日起可订购；Power Mount PoE Wired 将于 2027 年初上市，售价 129.95 美元（现汇率约合 871.4 元人民币）。
苹果 HomeView 显示屏支持 True Tone 自适应色温及自动亮度（0.3nits 至 500nits），界面会根据用户距离智能调整信息密度。
在界面个性化方面，HomeView 提供多种类似表盘的个性化显示界面，包括支持人像景深效果的照片（Photos）界面、能够根据人的存在和动作动态变化响应物理运动的流动（Flow）界面，以及可根据时间、天气、体育赛事和节日呈现动画的史努比（Snoopy）界面。用户还可以选择共享相册，将设备用作家庭电子相框。
音频方面，苹果在屏内集成了四个波束成形麦克风、两个定制全频驱动单元，底座中还内置了一个向下发声的低音炮，以及两个用于抵消振动的被动辐射器，并通过计算音频技术根据音量等条件实时优化声音表现。壁挂版没有底座，但有着针对墙面安装场景调校的双驱动单元和计算音频技术。
设备支持 Apple Music、Apple Podcasts、Apple News、Apple TV 及兼容的第三方音视频应用，还可通过 Handoff 接力功能将 iPhone 上正在播放的音乐流转至 HomeView，并与 HomePod、HomePod mini 等设备组成全屋多房间音频阵列；支持远场 Siri 语音识别；支持杜比全景声的空间音频。
在通信和家庭生活功能方面，HomeView 支持 FaceTime、Center Stage 人物居中、信息语音回复和屏幕键盘输入。用户可以通过 Intercom 广播功能向指定房间或整个家庭广播语音消息，也可以将网页食谱转换为分步骤操作说明，并使用免提计时器和食材跟踪功能。此外，设备支持“查找”和实时活动，可显示正在播放的歌曲、计时器状态以及来自其他房间的对讲消息。
HomeView 还可作为智能家居控制中枢，用户能够通过触控或 Siri AI 查看摄像头画面、调节恒温器和灯光、锁门或关闭百叶窗。
据介绍，Home Camera 界面最多可同时显示 9 路视频画面。搭配受支持的 iCloud+ 订阅和兼容摄像头后，设备还可通过端到端加密技术识别人员、熟悉的面孔、宠物、包裹和车辆，并在有人抵达前门时向家庭成员发送通知。
针对 HomeKit Secure Video 视频，该设备支持生成视频内容描述。此外，它还能检测烟雾报警器或一氧化碳报警器发出的声音，并向用户的 iPhone、iPad 或 Apple Watch 发送提醒。
苹果同时宣布推出 Apple Home Collection 智能家居产品系列，涵盖摄像头、恒温器和门锁，由苹果与 LG 电子、施耐德电气联合开发。同时，HomeView 也兼容其他支持 Works with Apple Home 和 Matter 标准的配件。

当与支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone 或 iPad 配对时，Siri AI 可调用用户的个人上下文，包括 Calendar、Messages 和 Apple Music 播放列表，实现跨应用操作。对话可从 HomeView 无缝延续至 Siri App，通过 iCloud 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple Watch 和 Apple Vision Pro 间私密同步。
隐私保护方面，HomeView 配备 A18 芯片和 Secure Exclaves 安全隔离运行环境，用于将摄像头和麦克风数据的处理与系统其他部分隔离。
苹果强调，在 Secure Exclaves 中处理和分析的数据无法被 HomeView 软件、应用、用户或苹果公司访问。信息和日历等个人内容只有在设备识别出已登记用户的面部，且其配对的 iPhone 或 iPad 在场并且近期已解锁时才会显示。Siri 请求则可在设备本地处理，也可通过隐私云端进行处理；苹果称，后者不会存储相关数据，也不会向苹果或其他任何人开放这些数据。
苹果表示，该产品不会在欧盟销售，原因是 Siri AI 目前在欧盟的 iOS 中不可用，苹果表示正与欧盟建设性合作以寻求解决方案。
HomeView 上的 Siri AI 目前在美国、澳大利亚、加拿大、印度、新西兰、新加坡、南非和英国提供英语版本，加拿大法语将在后续通过免费软件更新提供支持。

HomeView 采用铝合金机身设计，屏幕通过不锈钢铰链与半球形扬声器底座连接，支持倾斜调节，提供银色、星光色、玫瑰粉和深空灰四种配色，附赠同色线缆。

苹果同时宣布推出 Apple Home Collection 智能家居产品系列，涵盖摄像头、恒温器和门锁，由苹果与 LG 电子、施耐德电气联合开发。同时，HomeView 也兼容其他支持 Works with Apple Home 和 Matter 标准的配件。

当与支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone 或 iPad 配对时，Siri AI 可调用用户的个人上下文，包括 Calendar、Messages 和 Apple Music 播放列表，实现跨应用操作。对话可从 HomeView 无缝延续至 Siri App，通过 iCloud 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple Watch 和 Apple Vision Pro 间私密同步。
隐私保护方面，HomeView 配备 A18 芯片和 Secure Exclaves 安全隔离运行环境，用于将摄像头和麦克风数据的处理与系统其他部分隔离。

evidence.raw_lead: Despite featuring an A18 chip and built-in Apple Intelligence support, Apple's new HomeView still depends on a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad for several features. According to Apple's announcement, Siri requests involving personal context require a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad running the latest software, with Siri AI enabled and set to a supported language.

units.text: HomeView Needs an iPhone or iPad for Some AI Features
Despite featuring an A18 chip and built-in Apple Intelligence support, Apple's new HomeView still depends on a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad for several features.

According to Apple's announcement, Siri requests involving personal context require a paired Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or ‌iPad‌ running the latest software, with ‌Siri‌ AI enabled and set to a supported language. These capabilities include retrieving relevant information from Messages and Calendar, as well as taking action across apps using the user's personal context.

HomeView will still offer several ‌Siri‌ AI capabilities to users whose iPhone or ‌iPad‌ does not support ‌Apple Intelligence‌. Apple says these users can ask general-knowledge questions, hold natural conversations with ‌Siri‌, and benefit from improved music discovery. ‌Siri‌ requests on the HomeView can be processed on the device or through Private Cloud Compute.

Customizable ‌Siri‌ voices have more restrictive hardware requirements. Users can only adjust ‌Siri‌'s expressiveness and speaking pace on their paired device, with those preferences then carrying over to HomeView. This requires an iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro, or an ‌iPad‌ with an M4 chip or later and at least 12GB of unified memory. The feature is available in English only.

Some of the HomeView's intelligent camera features also depend on another Apple device. Video summaries and natural language searches of HomeKit Secure Video recordings require setup using an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or ‌iPad‌, along with an eligible iCloud+ subscription.
The HomeView launches on November 13, with both the tabletop and wall-mounted models priced at $299 in the U.S.

units.text: Apple has published the estimated service costs for its new HomeView smart home display, including how much customers can expect to pay with and without AppleCare coverage. Here are the details.
Out-of-warranty repairs could cost nearly as much as a new unit
Apple unveiled the HomeView today, a 7-inch smart display that is currently available for pre-order, with shipments beginning November 13.

Users can choose between two models: Apple HomeView and Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted). Both cost $299, but the wall-mounted model doesn’t come with a wall mount or power adapter. Those need to be purchased separately.
The standard HomeView, meanwhile, comes attached to a base with a more powerful built-in speaker system.
Following the announcement, Apple has now published the service and repair costs for the devices, both with and without AppleCare coverage.

According to Apple, the estimated service cost for either model is $279, listed under a single category: “Other damage.” There’s currently no breakdown for specific issues, such as a cracked screen or a faulty speaker on the standard model, suggesting that Apple may replace entire units rather than repair individual components.
Apple HomeView service costs withouh AppleCare on the left, with AppleCare on the right

Similarly, for units covered by AppleCare, the accidental damage service fee is currently listed at $39, regardless of whether the device is the standard or wall-mounted model, or the type of accidental damage. For AppleCare+ subscribers, HomeView coverage is available for $2.49 monthly, or $24.99 annually.
It’s worth noting that Apple hasn’t confirmed whether these fees cover full-unit replacements or repairs to individual components.
We’ll keep an eye out for any updates to Apple’s service and repair pricing, including whether the company adds more specific repair categories or fees.
To check out the “Apple Service and Repair for Apple HomeView” page, follow this link.

A19 chip, for up to 50% faster CPU performance and up to twice as fast graphics performance compared to the previous model with the A15 chip.

Three built-in far-field microphones for hands-free Siri AI voice control, but you can continue to use the Siri Remote if you prefer.

A built-in speaker that can play a sound to help you locate it.
The new remote is around 6% heavier than the previous version.

units.text: 苹果推出HomePod mini 2，在保留上一代紧凑球形外观的基础上新增粉色和绿色，原有蓝色、午夜色与白色也继续提供。AppleInsider称，新款内部处理器从初代的S5升级为S10；苹果官网目前确认新机高3.3英寸，并列出全频驱动单元、双被动辐射器、360度音场、温湿度传感器、Thread网络和超宽带芯片等功能。美国售价为149美元，现已开放预购，10月30日开始发售；相比初代上市时99美元的定价，新款涨价50美元。

新款的一项重要变化是支持通过多台HomePod mini 2与Apple TV 4K组建家庭影院环绕声系统。苹果官网说明，用户需要四台HomePod mini 2或第二代HomePod，并按前置、后置组成匹配的扬声器对，搭配第四代Apple TV 4K及最新版系统使用。两台同型号、同世代的HomePod mini 2也可配成立体声组合。苹果此前的支持页面仍称HomePod mini不支持Dolby Atmos 5.1或7.1声道，因此新页面所说的“环绕声体验”不应直接等同于支持这些具体音频格式。

苹果还强调，新款可提供多房间音频、智能家居中枢控制和名为Sound Glow的顶部灯光效果，灯光可随专辑封面颜色变化并跟随音乐节奏闪动。新版Siri AI也将登上HomePod mini 2，但苹果注明该功能需要未来的软件更新，推出时机尚未公布，使用还可能受到额度限制。Siri AI依赖支持Apple Intelligence的iPhone或iPad，苹果表示该功能初期不会在欧盟的iOS或iPadOS上提供。
HomePod mini 2继续支持苹果家庭生态中的设备控制和自动化，可作为HomeKit及Matter配件的家庭中枢，并内置温度与湿度传感器。苹果表示，新款可与新推出的Apple Home Collection配件协同工作；Home Collection配件需要运行最新系统的iPhone通过NFC完成配对，部分功能还需要兼容的家庭中枢。

units.text: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced HomePod mini 2, featuring Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and enhanced audio experiences. Siri AI,1 coming to HomePod mini 2 in a future software update, is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding, broad world knowledge that powers tasks like richer music discovery, and the ability to tap into even more apps — bringing a whole new level of capability to HomePod mini.2 Users can enjoy room-filling audio with a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or using multiroom audio. When paired with the new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 supports four-speaker surround sound — Apple’s most immersive home theater setup yet. And HomePod mini makes it easy for different users to manage the connected home with just a voice command, securely controlling accessories and running automations. HomePod mini 2 can be pre-ordered starting today in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability beginning Friday, October 30. “HomePod mini 2 brings together Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and incredible audio,” said Kaiann Drance, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Home Product Marketing. “With Siri AI, it understands you better than ever, drawing on personal context and broad world knowledge to make music discovery even richer. It fills a room with sound on its own, which gets even bigger in a stereo pair or with multiroom audio, and when paired with the new Apple TV 4K, it delivers our most immersive home theater setup yet. And with just your voice, HomePod mini makes it easy to securely control your accessories and run automations across the connected home.” Powered by an entirely new architecture built on the latest generation of Apple Foundation Models, Siri AI transforms the HomePod mini experience and helps users get more done than ever before. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, HomePod mini can tap into a user’s personal context to help them find what they need in the moment. HomePod mini can recognize up to six users in a household by their voice and securely connect to their device across apps like Messages and timers, while playing their favorite music, and more. Siri AI can also privately act on this context across a user’s iPhone and iPad apps to complete tasks like finding a song a friend recommended in a text, setting a reminder tied to a calendar event or location, locating a recipe from an email, or adding ingredients to a grocery list. With broad world knowledge, Siri AI can answer questions on almost any topic by getting up-to-date information from the web. And users can go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before. Once Siri AI is enabled on a supported HomePod mini speaker, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI’s broad world knowledge; its ability to have rich, natural conversations; and its improved music discovery. HomePod mini delivers rich 360-degree sound from its compact footprint, whether it’s used as a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or as part of a multiroom audio setup. Powered by the Apple S10 chip and advanced computational audio, it analyzes music in real time to optimize dynamic range, loudness, and acoustic performance. For the first time, users can create a four-speaker surround sound experience with Apple TV 4K (4th generation) and HomePod mini 2. Together, the four speakers and the new Apple TV 4K intelligently recognize each speaker’s position in the room, so audio timing and levels are automatically calibrated to the space.3 The new HomePod mini can serve as a speaker for Mac, delivering expansive sound for everything from movies and gaming to FaceTime and video calls.4 Finished in complementary colors, the new HomePod mini creates a beautifully unified desktop setup with Mac. With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini transforms into a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with the music, reacting in real time to bass and treble.5 The song’s album artwork from Now Playing generates a color-matched light experience that’s unique to every song, and users can pick a soundscape like rain to trigger bespoke animations for a soothing atmosphere.
With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini 2 becomes a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with music.

HomePod mini makes controlling the connected home easy at an incredible value. With just their voice, users can conduct a series of smart home actions, including locking the front door; closing the garage when leaving the house; and lowering the blinds, adjusting the thermostat, or turning off the lights at bedtime. With the Home app, users can automate their smart home accessories and create scenes to control multiple accessories at the same time. As a home hub, HomePod mini also lets users securely control accessories from the Home app on iPhone, whether they’re at home or away.6 Sound Recognition gives HomePod mini users peace of mind by listening for a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm and, if one is detected, sending a notification immediately to the user’s iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Using the Home app, users can check in via HomePod mini and listen and talk to someone at home to make sure everything is all right.7 The new HomePod mini also works seamlessly with smart home accessories, including Apple Home Collection8 video doorbells and cameras, using Face Recognition to announce who is at the door.9 As with every Apple product, privacy and security are foundational to HomePod mini. Siri AI takes full advantage of the bold new architecture for Apple Intelligence. Siri requests on HomePod mini 2 can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored or made accessible to Apple or anyone else. With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world’s most private digital assistant. HomePod mini 2 is built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomePod mini features 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled copper, gold plating, and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. HomePod mini 2 meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based10 and designed to be recycled. Pricing and Availability

Customers in the U.S. and more than 23 other countries and regions can pre-order HomePod mini 2 starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability in stores beginning Friday, October 30.
HomePod mini 2 is available for $149 (U.S.).
Siri AI will be available in English on HomePod mini 2 via a future software update in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK.
HomePod mini 2 is compatible with HomePod software 27.2.

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月14日消息，苹果日前正式发布了全新智能家居中枢设备 HomeView，起售价为299美元。随着新品亮相，苹果官网也公布了该设备的维修服务价格，其中未购买 AppleCare+ 的用户，意外损坏维修预估费用高达279美元，距离购买一台新设备仅相差20美元。 根据苹果官方支持页面，HomeView 提供桌面式和壁挂式两种版本，两款产品的维修收费标准相同。在没有 AppleCare 保障的情况下，苹果将相关维修归入“其他损坏”类别，预估费用为279美元；如果设备处于有效的 AppleCare+ 保障范围内，意外损坏维修服务费则降至39美元。 值得注意的是，苹果目前并未针对屏幕破裂、扬声器损坏等不同故障单独列出维修价格，也尚未明确维修时会更换整机还是单独更换受损部件。 针对 HomeView，苹果还提供了专属 AppleCare+ 服务。在美国市场，用户可以选择每月支付2.49美元，或每年支付24.99美元，两种方案均可持续续订直至取消。 此外，用户也可以将 HomeView 纳入 AppleCare One 保障计划，该服务起价为每月19.99美元，基础个人套餐最多可覆盖三台符合条件的苹果设备。 产品方面，HomeView 配备7英寸 Liquid Retina 显示屏，搭载A18芯片，支持升级后的 Siri AI、FaceTime 视频通话以及智能家居设备控制。桌面版本配有扬声器底座，壁挂版本则可以通过专用支架安装在墙面。 目前，HomeView 已在美国等市场开启预订，两种版本售价均为299美元，预计11月13日正式上市。

evidence.discovery_lead: 快科技10月13日消息，苹果首款带屏智能家庭中枢 HomeView 再次传出新消息，摄像头规格及部分智能识别功能提前曝光。 据消息人士 pdfu 爆料，其在 MacOS 26.7 RC1 系统代码中发现了 HomeView 的部分硬件信息。该设备可能采用索尼 IMX614 图像传感器，有效像素约1130万，支持拍摄3744×3024分辨率的照片，视频录制支持30FPS和60FPS。 除了视频通话，这颗摄像头还可能承担更多智能交互任务。 代码显示，HomeView 有望识别人体、人脸、手部以及猫狗等对象，并支持跨视频帧的人体追踪。其中，3D人脸追踪功能可以识别面部位置、旋转角度以及表情变化，再配合动作唤醒、距离检测和光源估算等功能，为设备提供更丰富的交互方式。 不过，相关代码并未显示红外传感器和 Face ID 面容认证支持。 此前还有消息称，HomeView 可能通过识别不同家庭成员，自动显示对应的日程、提醒等个性化信息。 其他硬件方面，根据此前爆料，HomeView 预计采用约6英寸方形触控屏，搭载 A18 芯片和8GB内存，并提供桌面式与壁挂式两种版本。桌面版本配有扬声器底座，壁挂版本则可安装在墙面，方便用户集中管理家中的智能设备。 软件方面，HomeView 预计以升级后的 AI 版 Siri 为核心，支持语音控制灯光、智能门锁及温控设备，同时整合 FaceTime 视频通话、日历提醒、音乐播放和家庭安防监控等功能。

evidence.title: 苹果新款Siri Remote兼容历代Apple TV 4K 旧设备也可升级使用 - Apple 苹果 - cnBeta.COM

units.text: 苹果在发布新一代Apple TV 4K的同时，也同步推出了全新的第四代Siri Remote遥控器。这款售价59美元的新产品虽然在外观上与上一代变化不大，但增加了多项实用功能，使其成为近年来升级幅度较为明显的一次迭代。
此次最大的改进来自“查找”功能支持。新款Siri Remote首次兼容苹果“查找”应用和精确查找（Precision Finding）功能，当用户找不到遥控器时，可以通过兼容的iPhone直接定位其位置。遥控器内部还新增扬声器，能够主动发出提示音，帮助用户快速找回设备。
苹果表示，精确查找功能需要搭配支持相关定位技术的设备使用，包括iPhone Duo、iPhone Air、iPhone 17以及iPhone 17 Pro等机型。
兼容性方面，新款Siri Remote并不仅限于刚刚发布的新Apple TV 4K，而是向下兼容多代产品。支持设备包括第四代Apple TV 4K、第三代Apple TV 4K、第二代Apple TV 4K、第一代Apple TV 4K以及Apple TV HD。这意味着大量现有Apple TV用户无需更换机顶盒即可获得新遥控器带来的定位功能升级。
除了Apple TV设备之外，这款遥控器还能够与Mac电脑建立连接，不过在缺乏额外软件支持的情况下，可实现的功能相对有限。
从设计上看，新款Siri Remote延续了近年来的铝合金机身设计方案，整体按键布局与前代产品基本保持一致。苹果此次的更新重点并非重新设计外观，而是在维持用户熟悉操作体验的前提下，解决长期以来用户最常遇到的“遥控器容易丢失”问题。
随着查找网络和精确定位能力的加入，新款Siri Remote也成为苹果家庭娱乐产品线中又一款深度整合“查找”生态的设备。对于已经拥有Apple TV HD或历代Apple TV 4K的用户而言，只需单独购买这款59美元的遥控器，即可获得新功能，而无需升级整套硬件系统。

evidence.discovery_lead: IT之家 10 月 14 日消息，苹果美国官网公布新款 HomeView 智能家居中枢维修价格， 在没有购买 AppleCare 保障的情况下，“其他损坏”服务费为 279 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,871 元人民币） ，接近 299 美元 （现汇率约合 2,005 元人民币） 的整机售价 ；而 AppleCare 用户意外损坏服务费为 39 美元 （现汇率约合 261.5 元人民币） 。 苹果公司昨日（10 月 13 日）发布 7 英寸智能显示屏 HomeView，目前已在美国等地开放预订，计划于 11 月 13 日开始发货，标准版与壁挂版售价均为 299 美元 （现汇率约合 2,005 元人民币） 。 维修选项方面，根据苹果服务页面信息，HomeView 目前未按屏幕破裂、扬声器故障等具体问题拆分维修项目，统一归入“其他损坏”类别。无论标准版还是壁挂版，无 AppleCare 保障的维修费均为 279 美元 （现汇率约合 1,871 元人民币） ，仅比整机售价低 20 美元 （现汇率约合 134.1 元人民币） ，约占新机售价的 93%。 对于购买 AppleCare 的用户，意外损坏服务费统一为 39 美元 （现汇率约合 261.5 元人民币） 。该费用同样不区分标准版或壁挂版，也不区分意外损坏类型。

evidence.title: IDC 称 2026Q3 中国智能手机出货跌 15.4%，华为逆势同比增长 17.3%
evidence.raw_lead: IDC 发布报告显示 2026 年第三季度中国智能手机市场出货量约 5790 万台，同比下降 15.4%，华为是头部厂商中唯一实现同比双位数增长的品牌，市场份额升至 21.1%。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，国际数据公司（ IDC ）最新手机季度跟踪报告初版数据显示，2026 年第三季度中国智能手机市场出货量约为 5,790 万台，同比下降 15.4% 。华为是头部厂商中唯一实现同比双位数增长的品牌。
整体市场：2026Q3 出货 5,790 万台，同比降 15.4%
相较上半年约 4% 的同比降幅，下半年整体市场规模下滑速度进一步加快。存储及其他元器件成本大幅上升所引发的终端价格上涨与产品配置方案调整，已开始明显抑制消费需求，其中安卓厂商与长尾品牌承受的压力尤为突出。
本季度市场呈现“量跌价升”的典型特征。上游成本压力持续向终端传导，导致新品定价普遍上浮，同时厂商不得不调整产品配置组合以平衡成本。
消费者面对价格上涨仍需时间适应，换机周期进一步拉长，直接拖累整体出货表现。这一趋势表明，成本压力已成为当前影响中国智能手机市场走势的关键变量。
厂商格局：华为份额升至 21.1%，荣耀环比微增
在整体低迷的背景下，华为凭借多样化的产品形态与相对克制的售价涨幅，延续了今年以来的强势表现，出货量实现同比两位数增长，市场份额升至 21.1% 。
苹果新品发布后市场欢迎度超出预期，但由于今年机型数量减少，出货量同比小幅下滑。其它中国头部品牌虽面临较大挑战，但依然展现出各自相应的承压能力。其中，荣耀成为头部厂商中唯一实现出货量环比增长的品牌，显示出一定的反弹趋势。
后市展望：价格体系重建前，市场难有起色
展望后市，预计存储及其他物料成本将在未来几个季度依然处于高位，手机产品价格将继续保持增长趋势。大部分消费者对价格上涨仍需接受与适应的时间，换机周期恐进一步拉长。
因此，即便有大量各档位新品集中发布，IDC 预计 2026 年第四季度中国智能手机市场表现依然难有起色。甚至到 2027 年大部分时间，成本压力仍将存在，市场预计仍将延续明显下滑趋势。
不过，头部厂商凭借较强的品牌拉力与相比竞争对手更有限的涨价幅度，有望在存量竞争中抢夺更多消费者。随着时间的推移，消费者势必逐步适应并接受新的手机价格体系，待新的换机节点到来，仍将更换手中设备，届时其它品牌也将迎来更多市场发展机会。

units.text: IT之家 10 月 13 日消息，苹果新款 Apple TV 4K 今日正式发布。该产品将于 11 月 13 日起正式发售，售价 2,399 港元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,050 元人民币）。
据官方介绍，Apple TV 4K 支持杜比视界和 HDR10+，可呈现生动逼真的 4K 画面，让每一个细节都栩栩如生。该机支持空间音频和杜比全景声功能，营造宛如四面八方而来的环绕立体声。
规格方面，Apple TV 4K 搭载 A19 芯片，CPU 性能相比上一代提升 50%，GPU 性能提升最高 2 倍，带来更快的响应速度和流畅播放体验。当然最重要的是，现在 Apple TV 终于支持了 Siri AI，当您将设备与 iPhone 或 iPad 配对后，您将可以更快找出喜欢的电影，或控制更多智能家居。
Apple TV 4K 内置三颗麦克风，用户无需拿着 Siri Remote 遥控器就能和 Siri 对话。新机支持环绕立体声，最多可配对四个 HomePod，全屋音频功能可将声音均匀地分布到四个 HomePod 上，带来更蓬勃的音效。
此外，Apple TV 4K 随附的 Siri Remote 遥控器现已支持“查找”功能，如果您找不到遥控器，只需要说一声“Siri，帮我找下遥控器”，它就会发出声音提示。该产品支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6、Thread、HDMI 2.1、千兆以太网，拥有 128GB 存储空间。
Apple TV 4K 将在 11 月 13 日起发售，定价 2,399 港元（现汇率约合 2,050 元人民币）。
